# `gameplay/society/FactionGraph.js`

> **Source:** `engine/gameplay/society/FactionGraph.js`

FactionGraph — Group souls with politics, reputation, and actions. Factions track: leader, values, laws, territory, resources, enemies/allies, fear, morale, population, reputation toward player, domain users, crimes, contracts.
